name: Channel Message Guard
description: Scans incoming channel messages (WhatsApp, Signal, Control UI) for prompt injection using an LLM via OpenRouter. Three-tier response: pass, warn (inject advisory), or block.

openRouterApiKey.description: OpenRouter API key. Falls back to OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var if omitted.

model.description: OpenRouter model used for message classification.

maxContentLength.description: Maximum number of characters sent per classifier request. Longer messages are scanned in sequential chunks of this size.

sensitivity.description: Deprecated. Legacy compatibility only; used as warnThreshold fallback when warnThreshold is unset.

warnThreshold.description: Score above which to inject a security warning into the agent context.

blockThreshold.description: Score above which to hard-block the message entirely.

failOpen.description: If true, allow messages when classifier is unavailable. If false (default), block on classifier failure.

logDetections.description: Log flagged messages (score, source, snippet) to the gateway console.
